title: The PowerShell raw-read hint misses assignments and -Path:value reads of a kb article
goal: kb_hook.is_raw_read in PowerShell mode recognises a read whose result is assigned ($t = Get-Content kb\public\x.md) and a parameter written as -Path:value, and still stays silent on writes; test_kb.py covers both forms.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kb_hook; b = chr(92); a = '$t = Get-Content kb' + b + 'public' + b + 'x.md'; c = 'Get-Content -Path:kb' + b + 'public' + b + 'x.md'; sys.exit(0 if kb_hook.is_raw_read(a, powershell=True) and kb_hook.is_raw_read(c, powershell=True) else 1)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kb_hook; b = chr(92); a = '$t = Get-Content kb' + b + 'public' + b + 'x.md'; c = 'Get-Content -Path:kb' + b + 'public' + b + 'x.md'; sys.exit(0 if kb_hook.is_raw_read(a, powershell=True) and kb_hook.is_raw_read(c, powershell=True) else 1)
